assessment.headline: DAY 38. 45-day ceasefire under discussion. Green Sanvi at Mumbai. Hormuz easing. But Tuesday deadline looms. This is the fork in the road.
assessment.body:
For the first time in 38 days, there is a credible path to peace.

Axios reports (4 sources) that the US, Iran, and regional mediators are discussing a possible 45-day ceasefire that could lead to a permanent end to the war. Iran's foreign ministry confirmed it has 'formulated its response to ceasefire proposals.' Oil fell to $108.76. Sensex rallied +800.

But simultaneously, Trump's Tuesday deadline remains on: 'Power Plant Day + Bridge Day. Open the F***in' Strait, you crazy bastards.' Dozen B1-B bombers arrived at bases in UK and Germany. Iran says Hormuz stays closed 'until fully compensated.'

The war is now on a knife's edge between two tracks:

TRACK A — CEASEFIRE (growing probability):
• 45-day ceasefire → Hormuz reopens gradually → Brent drops to $78
• Sensex rallies to 82,000+. Rupee recovers to 91. FII returns
• India's energy costs normalize. LPG drops back to ₹853
• But: Hormuz permanently tolled. Iran retains leverage

TRACK B — ESCALATION (still possible):
• Tuesday power plant + bridge strikes → Iran retaliates on Gulf infrastructure
• Brent spikes past $140. Sensex crashes 3,000+. Rupee past 96
• Houthis escalate on Red Sea. Both chokepoints threatened
• India's 60-day stock buffer starts depleting rapidly

HORMUZ IS EASING:
• 53 ships last week — most since war began (was 36 previous week)
• Iraq exempted from restrictions. Japan + Oman + France ships crossed
• Iran-Oman joint meeting planned on regulating passage
• But still 90% below pre-war levels

INDIA'S POSITION IS STRONG:
• Green Sanvi docked Mumbai TODAY — 46,650 MT LPG
• Sea Bird (Iranian LPG) at Mangalore — India buying Iranian fuel
• Iranian FM Araghchi called EAM Jaishankar today
• India buying from USA, Russia, Iran, Australia simultaneously
• 9 carriers crossed. Green Asha + Jag Vikram next
• 60 days stock. LPG 30+ days. Refineries >100%
• India supplying fuel to 5 neighbors

The next 36 hours determine everything. If the 45-day ceasefire materializes, this war enters its endgame — and India emerges as the diplomatic and energy winner of the conflict. If Tuesday's strikes happen, India enters the worst energy crisis since 1973.
